title: 4DGS canonical Gaussian bank plus logical motion Views
hypothesis: A compact time-conditioned motion View over shared canonical Gaussian geometry can replace independent per-motion deformation state while preserving held-out-time and held-out-view quality and render throughput.
physical_object: Shared canonical 3D Gaussian geometry and native 4DGS deformation decoder
mirror_coordinate: Low-description motion View conditioned on timestamp
logical_multiplicity: Multiple useful dynamic motion/frame functions from shared canonical Gaussians
controls_required: Official 4DGS canonical geometry plus native deformation field
Shared canonical geometry plus ordinary scene/motion embedding and deformation decoder
Independent per-motion Gaussian/deformation upper control where practical
success_gate: Not frozen; set against official 4DGS and ordinary scene/motion-code controls before fresh evaluation.
failure_gate: Not frozen; no model run occurred.
blocker: Official implementation uses CUDA rasterizer and simple-knn extensions and CUDA-bound train/render paths; available PyTorch is CPU-only and dynamic scene data is absent.
boundaries: Feasibility review only; no PSNR, LPIPS, payload, or FPS result.
Do not substitute a CPU toy renderer and call MA-896 complete.
